fields.subject: FW: Urgent: Cyber Incident Confirmation – Halden Automation Account Compromised
fields.note:
Anil,

We’ve reviewed the jump host logs from CVG-OT-JMP01 and can confirm: the integrator account 'halden-support' accessed the ROCLINK configuration for PC-21 and PC-22 at 16:15. A command to set both PC-21-SP and PC-22-SP to 13 in. w.c. was executed. The account has not been used in the past 72 hours. The command was not approved via the change control process in CVG-CRM-2025. This constitutes an unauthorized access to OT systems under SD Pipeline-2021-02G.

TSA is now designating this a Level 2 cyber incident. Please initiate full network segregation and notify CISA immediately per CVG-CIRP-2026 Section 9.

—TSA Contact: R. Thompson, Pipeline Security Division
fields.signature:
TSA Pipeline Security Division
Department of Homeland Security

original.subject: Urgent: Cyber Incident Confirmation – Halden Automation Account Compromised
original.body:
Hi Anil,

We’ve reviewed the jump host logs from CVG-OT-JMP01 and can confirm: the integrator account 'halden-support' accessed the ROCLINK configuration for PC-21 and PC-22 at 16:15. A command to set both PC-21-SP and PC-22-SP to 13 in. w.c. was executed. The account has not been used in the past 72 hours. The command was not approved via the change control process in CVG-CRM-2025. This constitutes an unauthorized access to OT systems under SD Pipeline-2021-02G.

TSA is now designating this a Level 2 cyber incident. Please initiate full network segregation and notify CISA immediately per CVG-CIRP-2026 Section 9.

—TSA Contact: R. Thompson, Pipeline Security Division

(Attachment: CVG-OT-JMP01_audit_trail_1615.pdf)
